design_principles: Every lesson has a communicative can-do outcome.
High-frequency vocabulary and curated topic vocabulary are separate curriculum streams.
Useful expressions and sentence frames are taught as first-class targets.
Grammar is introduced in service of communicative tasks and recycled later.
New material is deliberately recycled across later lessons and section checkpoints.
All four skills are tracked, while receptive and highly controlled production tasks dominate early A1.1.

Items in high_frequency_targets must be present in the current source-backed common vocabulary dataset; other useful items remain curated topic or expression targets until source frequency data is incorporated.

lesson_defaults.lexical_target_count_policy: advisory range; each lesson declares and is validated against lexical_target_count

sections.goal_en: Handle a few very common social exchanges with memorized words, short questions and supported responses.
sections.goal_fa: چند تعامل اجتماعی بسیار پرتکرار را با واژه‌ها، سؤال‌های کوتاه و پاسخ‌های تمرین‌شده انجام دهد.

lessons.can_do_en: Greet and say goodbye in a few routine situations.
lessons.can_do_fa: در چند موقعیت روزمره سلام کند و خداحافظی کند.
grammar_focus: fixed greeting formulas

assessment.criterion_en: Choose and produce an appropriate greeting in 4 of 5 routine prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Say your name and ask another person's name.
lessons.can_do_fa: نام خود را بگوید و نام طرف مقابل را بپرسد.
grammar_focus: olla: minä olen / sinä olet

assessment.criterion_en: Complete a two-turn introduction without hints.

lessons.can_do_en: Ask how someone is and give a short conventional answer.
lessons.can_do_fa: حال طرف مقابل را بپرسد و یک پاسخ کوتاه و معمول بدهد.
grammar_focus: formulaic partitive in Mitä kuuluu? / hyvää

assessment.criterion_en: Respond appropriately to three common wellbeing prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Answer yes/no and say that someone or something is not something.
lessons.can_do_fa: با بله و نه پاسخ دهد و یک نفی بسیار ساده بسازد.
grammar_focus: negation with ei + ole as a chunk

assessment.criterion_en: Choose and produce affirmative/negative replies in 4 of 5 prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Ask who a person is and what a familiar object is.
lessons.can_do_fa: بپرسد یک شخص چه کسی است یا یک شیء آشنا چیست.
grammar_focus: question words kuka / mikä; tämä + on

assessment.criterion_en: Form the correct kuka/mikä question for 4 of 5 supported situations.

lessons.can_do_en: Thank, apologize and use a basic polite response.
lessons.can_do_fa: تشکر کند، عذرخواهی کند و از پاسخ‌های مودبانهٔ پایه استفاده کند.
grammar_focus: imperative-like formula ole hyvä as a fixed expression

assessment.criterion_en: Select the culturally appropriate polite expression in 4 of 5 mini-dialogues.

lessons.can_do_en: Signal lack of understanding and ask for repetition or slower speech.
lessons.can_do_fa: بگوید متوجه نمی‌شود و درخواست تکرار یا آهسته‌تر صحبت‌کردن کند.
grammar_focus: 1st-person negation as a memorized frame

assessment.criterion_en: Use an appropriate repair phrase in three supported communication breakdowns.

lessons.can_do_en: Identify a few familiar objects using this/that.
lessons.can_do_fa: چند شیء آشنا را با «این» و «آن» معرفی کند.
grammar_focus: demonstratives tämä / se + olla

assessment.criterion_en: Describe five pictured familiar objects with tämä/se + on.

lessons.can_do_en: Combine greetings, name, wellbeing and repair phrases in short exchanges.
lessons.can_do_fa: سلام، معرفی، حال‌واحوال و درخواست کمک را در گفت‌وگوهای کوتاه ترکیب کند.
grammar_focus: recycling only

assessment.criterion_en: Complete two four-turn scripted dialogues with at most one hint.

lessons.can_do_en: Handle a supported first-contact interaction using the section's core language.
lessons.can_do_fa: یک تعامل اولیهٔ کوتاه را با زبان اصلی این بخش انجام دهد.
grammar_focus: checkpoint: greetings, olla, question words, simple negation

assessment.criterion_en: Reach at least 80% first-attempt accuracy across mixed section tasks.

sections.goal_en: Give a small amount of personal information and identify close people using short practiced sentences.
sections.goal_fa: مقدار کمی اطلاعات شخصی بدهد و افراد نزدیک را با جمله‌های کوتاه تمرین‌شده معرفی کند.

lessons.can_do_en: Refer to one or more people with basic personal pronouns.
lessons.can_do_fa: با ضمیرهای شخصی پایه دربارهٔ یک یا چند نفر صحبت کند.
grammar_focus: personal pronouns; olla 3sg/1pl/2pl/3pl as chunks

assessment.criterion_en: Choose the correct pronoun and olla form in 4 of 5 supported sentences.

lessons.can_do_en: Say where you are from and ask another person.
lessons.can_do_fa: بگوید اهل کجاست و همین سؤال را از دیگری بپرسد.
grammar_focus: elative -sta/-stä in memorized origin phrases

assessment.criterion_en: Ask and answer an origin question with a supported country name.

lessons.can_do_en: Say which language or languages you speak.
lessons.can_do_fa: بگوید به چه زبان یا زبان‌هایی صحبت می‌کند.
grammar_focus: language names use explicit partitive forms after puhua: suomea, persiaa, englantia

assessment.criterion_en: Produce a correct Puhun + language sentence for two languages.

lessons.can_do_en: Say where you live and ask where another person lives.
lessons.can_do_fa: بگوید کجا زندگی می‌کند و محل زندگی دیگری را بپرسد.
grammar_focus: inessive -ssa/-ssä in city names as a pattern

assessment.criterion_en: Ask and answer where someone lives using one familiar city.

lessons.can_do_en: Name a few close family members.
lessons.can_do_fa: چند عضو نزدیک خانواده را نام ببرد.
grammar_focus: basic possession as memorized frames

assessment.criterion_en: Identify five close family roles and introduce one person.

lessons.can_do_en: Express very simple possession with my/your.
lessons.can_do_fa: مالکیت بسیار ساده را با «من» و «تو» بیان کند.
grammar_focus: genitive pronouns minun / sinun; possessive forms as chunks

assessment.criterion_en: Distinguish and produce minun/sinun in four supported ownership prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Say your age and understand numbers from zero to twenty.
lessons.can_do_fa: سن خود را بگوید و اعداد صفر تا بیست را بفهمد.
grammar_focus: cardinal numbers 0–20; age frame with -vuotias

assessment.criterion_en: Recognize 8 of 10 spoken numbers and state an age correctly.

lessons.can_do_en: Understand and give a very short phone number or address with support.
lessons.can_do_fa: با کمک، شماره تلفن یا نشانی بسیار کوتاه را بفهمد و بیان کند.
grammar_focus: compound nouns; digit-by-digit production

assessment.criterion_en: Fill a simple contact card from a slow spoken or written prompt.

lessons.can_do_en: Understand and produce a few linked sentences about a person.
lessons.can_do_fa: چند جملهٔ پیوسته دربارهٔ اطلاعات شخصی یک فرد بفهمد و تولید کند.
grammar_focus: recycling complete reviewed personal-information frames; do not generate case forms by suffix concatenation

assessment.criterion_en: Extract four facts from a short profile and write a four-sentence supported profile.

lessons.can_do_en: Exchange basic personal information and identify close people.
lessons.can_do_fa: اطلاعات شخصی پایه ردوبدل کند و افراد نزدیک را معرفی کند.
grammar_focus: checkpoint: personal information, pronouns, origin, location, family, numbers

assessment.criterion_en: Reach at least 80% first-attempt accuracy across mixed section tasks.

sections.goal_en: Understand and produce highly practiced language about days, basic clock times and a simple routine.
sections.goal_fa: زبان بسیار تمرین‌شده دربارهٔ روزها، ساعت‌های ساده و برنامهٔ روزانه را بفهمد و تولید کند.

lessons.can_do_en: Distinguish today, tomorrow and yesterday in simple statements.
lessons.can_do_fa: امروز، فردا و دیروز را در جمله‌های ساده تشخیص دهد.
grammar_focus: time adverbs as fixed items

assessment.criterion_en: Choose the correct day reference in 4 of 5 prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Recognize and name the days of the week.
lessons.can_do_fa: روزهای هفته را تشخیص دهد و نام ببرد.
grammar_focus: weekday nouns; olla in date-like statements

assessment.criterion_en: Order all seven weekdays and identify a spoken weekday.

lessons.can_do_en: Understand and say simple whole-hour times.
lessons.can_do_fa: ساعت‌های کامل ساده را بفهمد و بیان کند.
grammar_focus: kello + cardinal number

assessment.criterion_en: Recognize and state four whole-hour times.

lessons.can_do_en: Identify and use morning, daytime, evening and night expressions in simple time phrases.
lessons.can_do_fa: عبارت‌های صبح، روز، عصر و شب را در عبارت‌های زمانی ساده تشخیص دهد و به‌کار ببرد.
grammar_focus: adessive time forms as chunks

assessment.criterion_en: Match four time-of-day expressions to the correct pictures or time contexts.

lessons.can_do_en: Say a few common things you do.
lessons.can_do_fa: چند کار روزمرهٔ رایج خود را بیان کند.
grammar_focus: present tense 1st person singular; selected verb chunks

assessment.criterion_en: Produce four supported minä + present-tense routine sentences.

lessons.can_do_en: Ask what another person does in a few familiar situations.
lessons.can_do_fa: دربارهٔ چند کار آشنا از طرف مقابل سؤال کند.
grammar_focus: 2nd person present; yes/no -ko/-kö questions as chunks

assessment.criterion_en: Ask two practiced routine questions and understand short replies.

lessons.can_do_en: Negate a few familiar routine verbs.
lessons.can_do_fa: چند فعل روزمرهٔ آشنا را در اول‌شخص منفی کند.
grammar_focus: 1st person negative: en + explicit connegative form; mappings are encoded in connegative_pairs

assessment.criterion_en: Transform four of the encoded familiar affirmative routine verbs into their explicit negative forms.

lessons.can_do_en: Ask and answer when a simple event happens.
lessons.can_do_fa: زمان یک رویداد ساده را بپرسد و پاسخ کوتاه بدهد.
grammar_focus: question word milloin; short time answers

assessment.criterion_en: Match five simple events with an appropriate time answer.

lessons.can_do_en: Understand and produce a short sequence describing a routine day.
lessons.can_do_fa: یک توالی کوتاه از برنامهٔ روزانه را بفهمد و بیان کند.
grammar_focus: sequence with time adverbs; recycling present tense

assessment.criterion_en: Order a five-event routine and produce three linked supported sentences.

lessons.can_do_en: Handle a highly supported exchange about day, time and routine.
lessons.can_do_fa: دربارهٔ روز، ساعت و برنامهٔ روزانه یک گفت‌وگوی بسیار هدایت‌شده انجام دهد.
grammar_focus: checkpoint: weekdays, whole hours, routine verbs, negation, when

assessment.criterion_en: Reach at least 80% first-attempt accuracy across mixed section tasks.

sections.title_en: Home, food and the familiar world
sections.goal_en: Identify familiar things, express a few basic needs, and describe a very small familiar world with practiced language.
sections.goal_fa: چیزهای آشنا را تشخیص دهد، چند نیاز پایه را بیان کند و دنیای کوچک آشنای خود را با زبان تمرین‌شده توصیف کند.

lessons.can_do_en: Name a few common places in a home.
lessons.can_do_fa: چند مکان رایج در خانه را نام ببرد.
grammar_focus: kotona as a fixed location form; tämä on

assessment.criterion_en: Identify five familiar home locations from pictures.

lessons.can_do_en: Say where a familiar object is using a few fixed location patterns.
lessons.can_do_fa: با چند الگوی مکانی ثابت بگوید یک شیء آشنا کجاست.
grammar_focus: limited -ssa/-ssä and -lla/-llä location chunks

assessment.criterion_en: Answer four supported Missä? questions with a practiced location phrase.

lessons.can_do_en: Recognize and name a few very common foods and drinks.
lessons.can_do_fa: چند خوراکی و نوشیدنی بسیار رایج را تشخیص دهد و نام ببرد.
grammar_focus: mass/count distinction only through memorized examples

assessment.criterion_en: Recognize five common food/drink items in pictures and slow audio.

lessons.can_do_en: Express one or two basic wants involving familiar food or drink.
lessons.can_do_fa: یکی دو خواسته یا نیاز پایه دربارهٔ خوراک و نوشیدنی را بیان کند.
grammar_focus: partitive object after haluan as a phrase pattern; minulla on as a chunk

assessment.criterion_en: Produce three supported want/need phrases with familiar items.

lessons.can_do_en: Make a minimal polite order for one familiar item.
lessons.can_do_fa: در یک کافه سفارش بسیار ساده و مودبانه بدهد.
grammar_focus: elliptical ordering phrases; recycling politeness

assessment.criterion_en: Complete a three-turn café dialogue for one item.

lessons.can_do_en: Recognize and name five common animals.
lessons.can_do_fa: پنج حیوان رایج را تشخیص دهد و نام ببرد.
grammar_focus: recycling demonstratives and olla

assessment.criterion_en: Identify and name five common animals.

lessons.can_do_en: Recognize five more familiar animals and group them broadly.
lessons.can_do_fa: پنج حیوان آشنای دیگر را تشخیص دهد و به‌طور کلی دسته‌بندی کند.
grammar_focus: simple noun predication with olla

assessment.criterion_en: Identify five additional animals and classify familiar examples as animals.

lessons.can_do_en: Describe a familiar person, object or animal with one basic adjective.
lessons.can_do_fa: یک شخص، شیء یا حیوان آشنا را با یک صفت پایه توصیف کند.
grammar_focus: adjective predicative with olla

assessment.criterion_en: Produce four supported noun + on + adjective descriptions.

lessons.can_do_en: Combine home, food, people and familiar objects in a few very short sentences.
lessons.can_do_fa: خانه، خوراک، افراد و اشیای آشنا را در چند جملهٔ بسیار کوتاه ترکیب کند.
grammar_focus: recycling only

assessment.criterion_en: Understand a five-sentence familiar-world text and produce four supported sentences.

lessons.can_do_en: Use memorized and highly practiced language across the core A1.1 situations.
lessons.can_do_fa: در موقعیت‌های اصلی A1.1 از زبان حفظ‌شده و بسیار تمرین‌شده استفاده کند.
grammar_focus: final checkpoint: first contact, personal information, time/routine, home/basic needs

assessment.criterion_en: Reach at least 80% first-attempt accuracy and complete one supported mini-dialogue plus one short profile/routine task.

prototype_mapping.notes: The current ten-lesson prototype remains an implementation testbed. Its useful targets are redistributed into the complete curriculum rather than treated as the final A1.1 sequence.
